original_idea.body:
# Mutation Operators for Preference Datasets

**Problem:** We lack a systematic way to ask which preference-data corruptions are most dangerous.

**Direction:** Define mutation operators, apply to HH-RLHF, run DPO, measure largest regression per unit of corruption.

**Why it matters:** A ranked kill matrix of data corruptions. No proprietary data.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2309.11274; arXiv:2503.11701; arXiv:2509.19325.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Ranking corruptions is useful but the catalogue overlaps existing poisoning/noise work; chain has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Defined operators plus DPO runs; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused kill-matrix; requires DPO per operator.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public data, no lab infra; independent-friendly diagnostic.

low_compute.reasoning: Multiple small DPO runs on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Components studied; systematic mutation-operator catalogue may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Individual corruptions studied; unified mutation-operator framing may be open.
